snapshot.text: Health services are run through Provincial Health Authorities, with very few doctors for the population and high burdens of TB and malaria. Australia, the US and WHO are major partners.

priorities.title: Stronger provincial health authorities
priorities.text: The health minister calls for stronger Provincial Health Authorities.

priorities.title: Malaria strategic plan 2026–2030
priorities.text: Provincial governors launched the 2026–2030 malaria plan.

priorities.title: Health MoU with the US
priorities.text: A new MoU with the US targets HIV and child survival.
